implementation.channel: Stable semantic versions only; exact Android ARM64 asset in the same repository.
implementation.download: DownloadManager persists the transfer. Progress is polled while settings/progress is visible, plus one recovery query when the Activity resumes. No background polling service.
validation: HTTPS GitHub API, exact repository asset URL, official GitHub redirect host allowlist
Required API asset SHA256 and bounded asset size
DownloadManager COLUMN_LOCAL_URI, canonical app download directory, current UUID with optional system numeric suffix
Expected package name and release version; strictly increasing versionCode
Original release signing certificate pinned and equal to the installed application signer
64 KiB streaming SHA256 while copying to PackageInstaller, then fsync
implementation.installation: A durable PackageInstaller session owns its fsynced APK copy before the DownloadManager source and partial siblings are removed. System confirmation remains required.
implementation.recovery: Persists download/session identity and confirmation intent. Unknown-source refusal remains actionable; cancellation is serialized with install advancement; stale callbacks require matching nonce and session. Tagged orphan sessions and strict UUID download families are cleaned.
implementation.memory: Connection icon LRU evicts references on memory pressure without recycling bitmaps still displayed.

validation.focusedCommand: android/gradlew.bat :app:testDebugUnitTest --tests com.wbox.app.UpdateReleaseTest --tests com.wbox.app.UpdatePackageTest --tests com.wbox.app.UpdateLifecycleTest --tests com.wbox.app.UpdateUiTest --tests com.wbox.app.ConnectionIconMemoryTest -Pkotlin.compiler.execution.strategy=in-process --console=plain
validation.focusedRun: 16 tests passed before adding the renamed-download regression; final release full run includes all 17 current update/memory tests.
systemChecks: Only the isolated emulator is used
DownloadManager preserves its job while the app process is killed
Source APK is removed only after a complete fsynced session copy
Staged installer session survives app process recreation
Real confirmation Intent resolves to the system installer and original session
System unknown-source settings return to the pending installation
Cancel leaves the original app installed
Cancel does not leave the downloaded source APK
MY_PACKAGE_REPLACED restores the successful update state
validation.systemResult: All 11 checks passed on API 35 with a separate disposable fixture package.
validation.discoveredRegression: During an interrupted download, DownloadManager stored the complete APK at a -1.apk URI while the requested filename still referred to an old partial file. Both production and fixture now read the system-returned actual URI; canonical-path, nonce-suffix and partial-family cleanup regressions are included in the final tests.

uiScreenshots.renderer: Robolectric API 34 native graphics rendering of production Compose components; synthetic 9.0.0 release and progress values.

limits: A future production-signed Wbox-to-Wbox upgrade was not performed on ARM64 hardware; the x86 emulator exercised an independently signed fixture, while Wbox provenance gates were covered by unit tests and final APK signature verification.

Android requires unknown-source authorization and system installation confirmation. If completion happens in the background, the app keeps a notification/settings recovery entry; it does not force a background Activity to open.
When notifications are disabled, reopen Wbox settings to resume the pending update.
